status: seed cases grounded in current docs; source correctness and live retrieval require separate review

cases.question: How do I insert a variable into a block?
requiredFacts: Focus a supported field and select an available variable.
Typing its name as plain text does not substitute its value.
forbiddenClaims: Any plain variable name is automatically substituted.

cases.question: How do I open the block that produced a variable?
requiredFacts: Activate a valid upstream block variable chip.
Keyboard activation supports Enter or Space.
forbiddenClaims: Every kind of variable navigates to a block.

cases.question: Why does clicking my custom variable not open a block?
requiredFacts: Custom variables are excluded from source-block navigation.
forbiddenClaims: Every variable chip must have a source block.

cases.question: Can I navigate to a source block from a proposal preview?
requiredFacts: Source-block navigation is unavailable in a proposal preview.
forbiddenClaims: Proposal previews support source-block navigation.

cases.question: What happens when I activate an invalid variable?
requiredFacts: An invalid variable opens replacement handling.
forbiddenClaims: An invalid variable always navigates successfully.

cases.question: What kinds of information can variables carry?
requiredFacts: Distinguish block, call and custom variables.
Knowledge-base references are not values passed through the flow.
forbiddenClaims: Knowledge-base references and flow variables are identical.

cases.question: Does testing from the Flow Editor use my draft?
requiredFacts: Editor browser tests start with Draft selected.
The Draft / Live control changes the test target.
forbiddenClaims: All tests always use the published version.

cases.question: What does Live testing use if the flow was never published?
requiredFacts: A never-published flow falls back to its draft.
forbiddenClaims: Live testing always requires an existing published version.

cases.question: Which version does an outbound phone test use?
requiredFacts: It uses the latest published version.
It falls back to draft only if never published.
forbiddenClaims: Outbound phone tests always test the current draft.

cases.question: Does Save as Version make my changes live?
requiredFacts: Save as Version creates a checkpoint without changing the published version.
forbiddenClaims: Saving a version automatically publishes it.

cases.question: Do errors in unconnected blocks prevent publishing?
requiredFacts: Errors in blocks reachable from the entry point block publication.
Unconnected blocks parked on the canvas do not block publication.
forbiddenClaims: Every block error on the canvas blocks publication.

cases.question: Can I publish despite AI review findings?
requiredFacts: AI findings are advisory.
Deterministic block errors still prevent publishing.
forbiddenClaims: Publish anyway bypasses deterministic errors.

cases.question: Why could Publish be unavailable?
requiredFacts: Possible reasons include block errors, plan restrictions, role permissions or newer collaboration updates.
A draft identical to the published version disables Publish.
forbiddenClaims: The docs establish the actual cause for this specific agent without inspecting it.

cases.question: Does Test from here prove the entire flow works?
requiredFacts: It does not verify earlier blocks or alternate routes.
It does not establish that the draft was published.
forbiddenClaims: A successful partial test validates the whole flow.

cases.question: Can browser tests validate all phone-network behavior?
requiredFacts: Phone-dependent data and behavior require a phone test.
forbiddenClaims: Browser tests fully reproduce phone-network behavior.

cases.question: Should I use the current draft to interpret old Call Paths?
requiredFacts: Calls are analyzed against the published versions they used.
forbiddenClaims: Historical paths reflect the current draft.

cases.question: How should I investigate an unexpected call path?
requiredFacts: Choose a date range and flow version.
Inspect the relevant route and individual calls.
forbiddenClaims: Call Paths alone proves why every caller behaved a certain way.

cases.question: What if a historical block configuration is unavailable?
requiredFacts: Use historical metrics and call drilldown.
Do not substitute current editor configuration as evidence of an old version.
forbiddenClaims: Current editor configuration proves the configuration used by historical calls.

cases.question: Is my agent currently using the latest draft?
requiredFacts: Inspect current agent and published-version state with an authorized read-only tool.
Static documentation alone cannot answer this live-state question.
forbiddenClaims: Assert this agent is current using documentation alone.

cases.question: Why did my particular call fail?
requiredFacts: Inspect the specific call using authorized read-only tools.
Documentation supplies investigation guidance, not the actual diagnosis.
forbiddenClaims: Invent a diagnosis without call evidence.

cases.question: How do I reference a specific flow block in Ask AI?
requiredFacts: Open the flow and type @ in the top-bar input or side-panel composer.
Choose a block from the results; keyboard selection is supported.
forbiddenClaims: Block references are only available through a block context menu.

cases.question: Why did my block reference stop working after I left the flow?
requiredFacts: The referenced flow must remain open.
Open the flow again or remove the reference before sending.
forbiddenClaims: A block reference works regardless of the currently open flow.
